name.full: Refract — AI Context & Prompt Trajectory Engine

description.short: Context & Prompt Trajectory Engine for Microsoft 365 Copilot.
description.full: Stop Copilot from guessing blindly. Refract grounds vague prompts in your active SharePoint files, Outlook emails, Teams chats, and calendar meetings, synthesizing 3 focused execution spectrums (⚡ Precision, 🔬 Root-Cause, 🛡️ Strict Executive Spec).
